gloss: thank you for your help; thanks for your trouble

cross_references.reading: おせわになっております
cross_references.headword: お{世話|せわ}になっております
cross_references.label: I am in your care

notes:
A polite expression acknowledging someone's effort or service. Slightly less formal than ⟦お{世話|せわ}になっております→お世話になっております：23569_osewaninatteorimasu⟧, which is the standard business greeting. Used when receiving a service or after someone has helped you.

USAGE:
Commonly said to delivery workers, maintenance staff, and service providers as a quick thank-you. Can also be used in ongoing business relationships as a semi-formal greeting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{世話様|せわさま}でした: thank you for your help (past)
- お{世話様|せわさま}です: thank you for your help (present/ongoing)
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧お{世話様|せわさま}です: thank you always for your help

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{世話|せわ}になっております→お世話になっております：23569_osewaninatteorimasu⟧: I am in your care — more formal, standard business greeting
- ⟦お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}→お疲れ様：05208_otsukaresama⟧です: thank you for your hard work — used among colleagues
- ⟦ご{苦労|くろう}{様|さま}→ご苦労様：18374_gokurousama⟧です: thank you for your efforts — used from superior to subordinate

definitions.gloss: thank you for your help; thanks for your trouble
definitions.explanation: an expression of gratitude for someone's help or service, acknowledging the trouble they have taken
